data.name: Greesha
data.gender_notes: Greesha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Greesha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Gree’, meaning ‘knowledge’ or ‘wisdom’. The suffix ‘sha’ denotes the feminine gender. Therefore, Greesha is the goddess of knowledge or wisdom. The name Greesha carries the meaning “Goddess of Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Greesha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Greesha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Greesha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Greesha embodies the essence of a wise and enlightened individual, inspiring countless generations to pursue knowledge, learning, and self-improvement. The name is synonymous with intelligence, insight, and intuition. In certain Hindu traditions, Greesha is also considered a manifestation of the goddess Saraswati, the deity of learning and arts.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Greesha symbolizes the inner search for knowledge, understanding, and wisdom. The name is a call to delve deeper into oneself to uncover the hidden truths and wisdom that lies within. It is a reminder that knowledge is not merely an accumulation of facts and figures but an awakening of the mind, spirit, and consciousness. By embracing the name Greesha, one can connect with the divine source of knowledge and wisdom, ultimately leading to a greater sense of self-awareness, inner peace, and spiritual growth.
